network_enforcement: The checker runs each Lean elaboration through the existing bubblewrap --unshare-net validation runner. It makes no network request. This does not turn the shared warm dependency cache into release-grade cold hermetic evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release status summary

scope_boundary: Worker-side negative release reconciliation and a network-isolated, temporary-directory, warm-cache Lean replay. This recipe does not provide dependency or master acceptance, accepted H0/R0 or trust closure, an immutable clean empty-cache cold build, offline restoration, complete SBOM/licenses, distinct signed runners, an independently implemented verifier, protected release CI, or a deterministic release bundle.
